mapper.select: SELECT sh.id, sh.title, sh.purpose, sh.total_target_count, sh.success_count, sh.fail_count, sh.status, sh.scheduled_at, sh.completed_at, sh.created_at FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(sh.completed_at, sh.scheduled_at, sh.created_at) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
